scope: Change set 63818ee..796acd1: four golden-path findings from the Opus 5 and Fable 5.1 audit, plus the review-gate defect that surfaced when the first record of them passed locally and failed in CI

Round band3-1 accepted the golden-path work (6de7a57) with eleven named checks over a 258,000 character packet. Round reviewgate-1 then REJECTED the branch with a P0: the record on it was pinned to a digest no clean checkout reproduces. This record is the fix for that, made on a pristine clone with the corrected tool

evidence.command: tools/review_gate.py --digest on the recording machine, before the fix
evidence.result: 836 files, 81266fe8a5a9..., because four probe workspaces sat under the gitignored products/

evidence.command: tools/review_gate.py --digest on a pristine clone of the same commit
evidence.result: 824 files, 76bc6270227f..., which is why hosted CI reported readiness-local failing on 1 criteria while the same tree passed 25 of 25 locally

evidence.command: after adding products to ROOT_SKIP_DIRS, creating a real workspace with init_product.py
evidence.result: the digest is byte-identical before and after, so a reviewer's own product no longer moves the tree a record is pinned to
Ran 72 tests, OK; 70 before and 2 added, one for the skip and one proving a force-added file under products/ still moves the digest

findings.summary: The branch carried a CI-6 record pinned to a tree digest no clean checkout reproduces, so the gate it satisfies could only ever pass on the machine that wrote it
findings.evidence: Raised by round reviewgate-1 against 796acd1 and resolved by this record, which is made on a pristine clone with products excluded from the digest

findings.summary: The failure a reader sees when this happens says only that readiness-local is failing on 1 criteria, and never that the recorded digest and the live tree differ or by how much
findings.evidence: Cost one full CI cycle to diagnose by hand; the gate could print the two digests and the file counts it compared
